verdict.rationale: Graphite publishes an official MCP server, GT MCP, documented at graphite.com/docs/gt-mcp. It lets AI agents create stacked PRs automatically, splitting large AI-generated changes into smaller reviewable pull requests, and a probe confirmed the official docs page exists. Graphite is a code-review and stacking platform rather than just an agent, so serving tools to external agents applies here. Missing for 10: setup/connection instructions and the full tool list are not in the evidence, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting via GT MCP.
